web.description:
## Why Most Developers Need a Form Backend Service
- **Static Sites Have No Server.** GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, and plain HTML files cannot process form submissions. The moment a user clicks submit the browser has nowhere to send the data. You need a form backend to receive it.

## Works with the stacks you already publish
